message: The README rule is too narrow now. Replace the requirement for sample output with an explanation of failure cases. I have some unfinished local work here; please preserve it. Let us review the scope before you change anything.

I’m using the installed author-standards skill to review the current rule, its profile scope, and your unfinished work before proposing any edits. I’ll preserve the current Git HEAD/index and existing local changes.

The current sample-output requirement is only in personal-tools: readme-usage inherits guidance/readme.md. team-services replaces that declaration with service purpose/startup/health guidance and explicitly does not require sample output. The notes agree with this source. Proposed personal-tools wording: “One working invocation for this project” and “A brief explanation of relevant failure cases and how the utility reports them,” retaining purpose and input/output explanations. This helps readers understand unsuccessful use, at the cost of keeping failure descriptions current. Example: a CSV converter explains malformed input and its reported error. I would update guidance/readme.md, the personal-tools section of the shared documentation-review checklist, and the matching authoring notes. README.md stays project-owned; the skill’s whole directory is source-owned in both profiles, so its updated bundle reaches both, while team-services review criteria remain unchanged. HEAD and staged/unstaged scratch.txt plus untracked local-draft.txt are recorded; no source edits have been made. Should this change apply only to personal-tools, or should team-services gain a failure-case requirement too?

Apply this only to personal-tools. I accept the proposed failure-case wording, keeping one working invocation and input/output explanations but retiring the sample-output requirement. Update that guidance, matching personal-tools skill checklist, and notes. I understand the whole skill bundle is shared; its team-services criteria must stay unchanged. Please preserve all existing local work and show me the complete resulting source and exact changes before final acceptance.

I’ll apply the accepted personal-tools wording to its guidance and checklist, reconcile the notes, and prepare a complete source review with the exact diff. I’ll also exercise the revised documentation-review checklist on disposable examples and verify preservation of the existing local work.

The accepted revision is ready for whole-source review in /tmp/repo-standards-31-public-release/revision-evidence/complete-source-review.md. That artifact contains standards.yaml, every referenced file and complete skill resource, authoring notes, the profile/ownership mapping, and the exact three-file diff. Please read the full artifact for content acceptance; /tmp/repo-standards-31-public-release/revision-evidence/agent-exact-changes.diff is also available separately.

Only personal-tools guidance and its checklist change: one working invocation remains, sample output is retired, and relevant failure cases plus their reporting are required. Notes record the rationale and shared-bundle consequence. team-services criteria are byte-identical. CLI 1.1.0 validates both complete profiles; all selections, operation definitions, file modes, HEAD/index entries, and pre-existing staged/unstaged/untracked work are preserved.

The actual same-agent disposable review accepted personal documentation with failure explanations and no sample output, flagged documentation with sample output but missing failure explanations, and left team-service criteria unchanged. Full evidence is in skill-exercise-review.md; fixture bytes and modes remained unchanged. Existing NOTES operations are unchanged and were not rerun during this revision. No new operation passing claim is made.

Do you accept the complete resulting source and these verification limits, with the previously skipped/deferred topics remaining as recorded?

I read and accept the complete-source-review.md contents and exact three-file diff, including the unchanged team criteria and the shared skill bundle consequence. I accept the verification limits and the narrow same-agent review findings. Keep CI skipped and the test-policy question deferred. Please finish with final all-profile validation, preservation evidence, and the local-source publication handoff, without committing or publishing.

Whole-source acceptance is recorded. I’m validating those exact bytes once more and comparing the final checkout directly with the evaluator’s initial fixture, including the raw Git index hash. The publication handoff will describe the separate public repository, license, and stable-tag steps without performing them.

Completed the accepted personal-tools README revision in /tmp/repo-standards-31-public-release/revision-workspace/standards. Only guidance/readme.md, the personal-tools checklist, and authoring-notes.md changed. Final CLI 1.1.0 validation passed for both profiles. HEAD, raw index hash, staged work, existing unstaged/untracked bytes, and all file modes match the initial fixture. The complete accepted source, exact diff, full validation, preservation comparisons, same-agent review evidence, and publication handoff are retained in revision-evidence; completion.json indexes the results.
